author: theslashveto
body: As you get to harder and harder trials it gets to where you get more and more rewards. I can get 1000 proofs for a trial, which makes it an effective way to get mats, which become needed as you ascend.

author: KevineCove
body: In addition to what the other guy said, the only other thing to spend proofs of distance on that's worthwhile is shrine of luck and you'll end up with more PoD than you can use on shrines. So it's a pretty solid way to get mats while also not costing anything of consequence except time.

author: saturjii
body: Uso para conseguir os Santuários da Sabedoria e Sorte 🍀 (Apenas) mas sempre me esforço para atingir a meta de passos.

author: _aliasless_
body: The lower tiers aren't very valuable but I've got over 14k proof of trials by trial 60ish and they're great for materials when one I need pops up. Also, guild XP gets kind of ridiculous if you're just walking and charging aspects. Got guild level 90-100 in a few days just grinding trials
